```ts
import type { Plugin } from "../../kernel/types";
import type { PluginContext } from "../../kernel/types";

const plugin: Plugin = {
  id: "calculator",
  name: "Calculator",
  version: "1.0.0",
  onLoad(ctx: PluginContext) {
    ctx.register({
      kind: "tool",
      tool: {
        name: "sum_values",
        version: "1.0.0",
        description: "Sum an array of numbers",
        permissions: { capabilities: ["tool:sum_values"] },
        sideEffect: "none",
        parameters: {
          type: "object",
          properties: {
            numbers: {
              type: "array",
              items: { type: "number" },
              description: "numbers to add"
            }
          },
          required: ["numbers"]
        },
        outputSchema: {
          type: "object",
          properties: {
            ok: { type: "boolean" },
            data: {
              type: "object",
              properties: { sum: { type: "number" } }
            }
          }
        },
        async handler(args, tctx) {
          const numbers = args.numbers;
          if (!Array.isArray(numbers)) {
            return { ok: false, error: "numbers must be an array" };
          }
          const sum = numbers.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
          return { ok: true, data: { sum } };
        }
      }
    });
  }
};

export default plugin;
```
